senses.gloss: m. pl. (an adaptation of cancelli; reduplic. of קִיל I; cmp. קוֹלְיָינִין) curtained enclosures, compartments. Pesik. Vayḥi, p. 8ᵃ, v. קוֹלְיָינִין.—Esp. the curtained enclosures of an idolatrous temple.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 51b:15">Ab. Zar. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שהוא לפנים מן הק׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="S01293"><he>קלוקלון</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00361"><he>קולקלון</he></cite>, corr. acc.) whatever is found within the enclosures is forbidden, even if it be water or salt; whatever is outside &c.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 51b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>אין ק׳ לא לפעור וכ׳</he> no difference is made between things within and without the enclosures as regards the idol Peor &c.—Cmp. <cite ref="S01610"><he>קַנְקָל</he></cite>.
